#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <numeric>

using namespace std;

static int pow_mod(int b, long long e, int mod) {
    int ans=1;
    b%=mod;
    while(e>0) {
        if((e&1)==1)
            ans=(int)((ans*1ll*b)%mod);
        e>>=1;
        b=(int)((b*1ll*b)%mod);
    }
    return ans;
}

static long long ncr(int n, int r, const vector<int>& fac, int mod) {
    long long ans=fac[n];
    long long de=((long long)fac[n - r] * fac[r]) % mod;
    de=pow_mod((int)de, mod-2, mod);
    return (ans * de) % mod;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    long long k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    const int mod=998244353;

    if(k > n - 1) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    
    vector<int> fac(n+1);
    fac[0]=1;
    for(int i=1; i<=n; ++i)
        fac[i] = (int)((fac[i-1]*1ll*i)%mod);

    int pop = n - (int)k;
    long long ans=0;
    for(int i=0; i<=pop; ++i) {
        long long notPop= (ncr(pop,i,fac,mod)*pow_mod(pop - i, n, mod))%mod;
        if(notPop<0) {
            cout << "here\n";
        }
        if(i%2==1) notPop*=-1;
        ans += (notPop + mod);
        ans %= mod;
    }
    ans = (ans * ncr(n,pop,fac,mod))%mod;
    if(k != 0)
        ans = (ans*2) % mod;
    cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
